# E4: futex system calls made by racelab (1000000 increments per thread), counted with
#   strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode M [--threads 1] --iters 1000000
# Generated by experiments/run_e4.sh on kernel 6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2, 16 CPUs, strace -- version 6.8.
# Each run takes and releases the lock 1000000 x threads times; compare that with the futex calls.
# 3-5 calls are unavoidable bookkeeping: the start barrier and pthread_join (the exiting thread's
# CLONE_CHILD_CLEARTID futex wake). Under strace the timing changes, so contention does too.

== mode=mutex threads=2 (contended)
$ strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode mutex --threads 2 --iters 1000000
mode=mutex threads=2 iters=1000000 expected=2000000 final=2000000 error=0 lost_pct=0.000 runtime_ms=28.83 ns_per_increment=14.4
% time     seconds  usecs/call     calls    errors syscall
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.010858          27       396       134 futex
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.010858          27       396       134 total

== mode=mutex threads=1 (uncontended: one thread)
$ strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode mutex --threads 1 --iters 1000000
mode=mutex threads=1 iters=1000000 expected=1000000 final=1000000 error=0 lost_pct=0.000 runtime_ms=6.56 ns_per_increment=6.6
% time     seconds  usecs/call     calls    errors syscall
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
  0.00    0.000000           0         3           futex
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.000000           0         3           total

== mode=semaphore threads=2 (contended)
$ strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode semaphore --threads 2 --iters 1000000
mode=semaphore threads=2 iters=1000000 expected=2000000 final=2000000 error=0 lost_pct=0.000 runtime_ms=43.45 ns_per_increment=21.7
% time     seconds  usecs/call     calls    errors syscall
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.036112          60       593       229 futex
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.036112          60       593       229 total

== mode=semaphore threads=1 (uncontended: one thread)
$ strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode semaphore --threads 1 --iters 1000000
mode=semaphore threads=1 iters=1000000 expected=1000000 final=1000000 error=0 lost_pct=0.000 runtime_ms=7.54 ns_per_increment=7.5
% time     seconds  usecs/call     calls    errors syscall
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
  0.00    0.000000           0         3           futex
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.000000           0         3           total

== mode=spinlock threads=2 (contended)
$ strace -f -e trace=futex -c build/racelab --mode spinlock --threads 2 --iters 1000000
mode=spinlock threads=2 iters=1000000 expected=2000000 final=2000000 error=0 lost_pct=0.000 runtime_ms=31.31 ns_per_increment=15.7
% time     seconds  usecs/call     calls    errors syscall
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.005251        1312         4           futex
------ ----------- ----------- --------- --------- ----------------
100.00    0.005251        1312         4           total
